title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 83
paragraphs: Argos, however, was so stripped of men that its slaves seized control of the whole state, running and managing it until the sons of the slain grew to manhood. These, trying to recover Argos for themselves, drove the slaves out; and the slaves, expelled, fought their way into possession of Tiryns. For a time the two parties kept friendly relations with each other, but eventually there came to the slaves a prophet named Cleander, a Phigalian from Arcadia by birth. This man persuaded the slaves to attack their old masters, and as a result there was a long war between them, until at last the Argives, with difficulty, prevailed.
